name: Abjuration Adept

source.note: Compared with the published D&D Beyond chapter on 2026-10-06: https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/au/chapter-1-character-options.

summary: Always prepare these spells when you have slots of levels 1, 2, 3, 4, and 5 respectively: Shield; Lesser Restoration; Protection from Energy; Banishment; Mass Cure Wounds. Reference-only: After a slotted Abjuration, you or a visible creature within 30 feet gains Temporary HP equal to twice slot level.
